digest.component_or_area: fsck snapshot rebuild and event store compaction
propositions: fsck snapshot rebuild silently drops folded source events that exist only in prior SNAPSHOT's compiled_state when compaction deleted originals before the Jul-7 fix
rebuild_snapshot_from_full_log replays from surviving files without detecting incomplete logs, causing order-sensitive STATUS events to be lost when pre-snapshot deletions are undetectable
fsck --dry-run does not cover --repair-snapshots path, allowing mutations when read-only preview is intended
214 tickets reverted from closed status due to missing STATUS events during a3 remediation batch fsck repair runs
fsck must fail closed and refuse lossy rebuilds when SNAPSHOT cites source_event_uuids with no corresponding files on disk
restore_deleted_sources must recover deleted event files from git history and complete incomplete logs before rebuild proceeds
